business_problem: Decagon needed to automate complex customer support conversations at high volume while keeping latency low, preserving nuanced responses, and adapting to each client’s business logic and workflows.
solution_summary: Decagon built a configurable support-automation platform that combines multiple OpenAI models across the customer-service pipeline. Fine-tuned GPT-3.5 rewrites incoming customer queries before they enter retrieval-augmented generation workflows, while GPT-4 handles more complex decisions such as API-driven actions and intricate operations. The broader platform can also draw on GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo, and OpenAI o1-mini so each stage of the interaction uses the model best suited for its speed and reasoning needs. This model orchestration lets Decagon capture client-specific business logic, generate tailored software surfaces around each agent, and rapidly test new model releases through evaluations. Customers use the platform to run fast, mostly autonomous support operations at global scale, and Decagon can bring the core infrastructure online for a new customer in days while continuing to explore voice as the next automation frontier.

data_flow: Incoming support questions are rewritten with fine-tuned GPT-3.5, passed through retrieval and business-logic workflows inside the Decagon platform, and then routed to GPT-4 or other OpenAI models for response generation or API actions. The resulting outputs are evaluated continuously and returned either directly to customers or used to expand automation coverage.
business_outcome: Decagon enabled highly automated support for large clients, shortened onboarding for new deployments, and kept its platform current by quickly evaluating new OpenAI models for accuracy and efficiency gains.
